extract: Mechagon Island (displayed as just Mechagon in the overworld) is an island located northwest of Kul Tiras. Added in patch 8.2.0, it features one zone, a megadungeon (Operation: Mechagon), and an arena (the Robodrome).

Added in [[patch 8.2.0]], it features one zone, a megadungeon ([[Operation: Mechagon]]), and an arena (the [[Robodrome]]). ==Description== ''A mystery awaits that is of particular interest to the [[gnome]]s and [[goblin]]s. A previously [[Abandoned Junkheap|closed vault]] in [[Kul Tiras]] has opened and within it a radio transmitter sends a signal for help and points to a new land to explore, Mechagon. This is an ancient lost city of the gnomes. The beginning of the adventure is within the [[Junker Wastes]] where heroes will be beset by [[death robot]]s, but there are potential allies nearby. Hunted by robots themselves, the [[Mechagon mechagnome|mechagnomes]] introduce you to a whole new society and take you to where higher cast gnomes live who have dedicated themselves to their king and have embraced robotics.'' ''[[King Mechagon|King Mechagon]] has a vision to return anyone of flesh into more pure robotic parts and it's up to you to put a stop to him.''{{Ref web|url=https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/22646758/|title=World of Warcraft: What's Next Panel Recap|author=Blizzard Entertainment|date=2018-11-02|accessdate=2019-04-08}} ==History== ===Ancient times=== In ancient times, [[Mimiron]] built a vault here in which he kept technological and [[titan]] marvels.https://www.wowhead.com/news=288418/blizzcon-2018-interview-with-ion-hazzikostas-and-chris-robinson-azshara-raises-n Before [[King Mechagon]] claimed the island, other civilizations lived upon it. The history of these forgotten people was buried beneath the land.[[Clues Abound]] Evidence of two different civilizations appear, with one having been [[vrykul]] in origin[[A Growing Mystery]] and the other appearing to have been [[tortollan]]s.[[A Historical Mess]] In addition, the discovery of a giant clockwork hammer, too big for any mechagnome to wield, possibly indicates the existence of an earlier mecha-civilization on the island.[[Golden Clockwork Power Hammer]] A very old [[Night elf|night elven]] ring has also been found on Mechagon, raising more questions about the island's past.[[Strange Discovery]] It seems [[pirate]]s were also active around the area.[[Pirates? I Hate Those Guys!]] ===Foundation of Mechagon=== King Mechagon was once the king of the [[Gnomeregan (kingdom)|Gnomeregan]] [[gnome]]s, who 400 years ago''[[World of Warcraft]]'' [[World of Warcraft: Game Manual|manual]], pg. 175 led his followers in search of a mystical land of technology. He left no clues where he was headed and over time his tale became a legend to the gnomes.[[The Legend of Mechagon (Alliance)]] In truth, King Mechagon managed to find this land and claimed it as his own. Since then, Mechagon Island has become the lost home of the [[Mechagon mechagnome|mechagnome]]s.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RxmcFWVq2oE Rise of Azshara Survival Guide], 01:35 Under the guidance of [[Walton Cogfrenzy]], the gnomes erected the mighty underground marvel of [[Mechagon City]].[[Walton Cogfrenzy]] gossip dialogue Under King Mechagon, the gnomes began to convert themselves into partially mechanical versions of themselves; thus removing the problems of age upon their society. ===Rediscovery=== {{comic-section}} Centuries later, King Mechagon decided that the time had come to remove the [[Curse of Flesh]] from all [[Titan-forged|titan creations]]. He was busy creating the [[Mechoriginator]], a machine he'd been perfecting in order to achieve his goal. Not wanting to see his father's plan come to fruition, [[Prince Erazmin]] began to secretly plan a revolt against him. His plans were unfortunately discovered when the elderly gnome adventurer, [[Kervo Cogpipe]], single-handedly found his way to the legendary lost island and told the king of his betrayal. With no other choice, Prince Erazmin fled to [[Rustbolt]] with all those who supported him,''[[Mechagon (comic)|Mechagon]]'' leading to a civil war between the [[Rustbolt Resistance]] and the [[Arcforged]] loyalists. ===Battle for Azeroth=== {{bfa-section}} Ignorant of this conflict, forces of the Alliance and Horde had heard of a vault being discovered at the [[Abandoned Junkheap]]. An expedition under [[Tinkmaster Overspark]] were the first to arrive and were able to open the vault. Inside, they managed to activate a message by [[King Mechagon]], which unfortunately was followed by the activation of a scanning device that killed all those who were not gnomes. It only stopped when [[Gila Crosswires]] was scanned.[[Fame Waits for Gnome One]][[The Legend of Mechagon (Alliance)]] As the Alliance forces left the vault, a group led by [[Gazlowe]] had learned of the vault as well and had just arrived as they were leaving. With Overspark's departure, the Horde invaded the vault and killed all except for one gnome. Just as the Alliance did, the Horde activated the message and suffered the same fate until Gazlowe got the idea of using the captured gnome to stop the sequence.[[Rumors of Mechagon]][[The Legend of Mechagon (Horde)]] Arriving on the island, Overspark and Gazlowe were greeted by Prince Erazmin who explained the situation. Both sides agreed that despite being at [[Fourth War|war]], they would help the rebellion.[[Princely Visit]][[We Come in Peace... and Profit]] With everything settled, Erazmin gave a tour of the island. He explained that Rustbolt was recently ransacked and he will need help to launch an assault to rescue his supporters. With help from both sides, the prince attacked [[Junkwatt Depot]] to free his captured allies and also regain [[Pascal-K1N6]].[[The Resistance Needs YOU!]][[Drill Rig Construction]][[Rescuing the Resistance]][[My Father's Armies]][[We Can Fix It]] Before leaving, the prince decided to deliver a message to his father by damaging the [[HK-8 Aerial Oppression Unit]].[[Send My Father a Message]] Arriving back at Rustbolt, he informed both forces that there was much to be done before advancing onto the next phase.[[Welcome to the Resistance]] When preparations were complete, the allied forces launched [[Operation: Mechagon]], leading to the tyrant King Mechagon's end. ====Alternate universe==== [[File:Operation- Mechagon AU.png|thumb|Mechagon Island's alternate universe.]] In an alternate universe, just as everything seemed to go well for the rebellion, [[Bondo Bigblock]] sold them out. In exchange for full mechanization, Bondo built giant bots and attacked Rustbolt. Soon after the successful invasion, a hologram of King Mechagon appeared in the middle of the base and declared victory. Following his triumph, he activated the [[Mechoriginator]] and destroyed all life on Azeroth. In the aftermath, Christy Punchcog and Izira Gearsworn were some of the few who survived. Izira's legs were destroyed, so Christy with the help of an adventurer was able to create a new set of legs for her.[[Adapt, Improve, Overcome!]] After getting back on her feet, Izira decided to go after [[Bondo Bigblock]] as revenge and killed him.[[The Final Act]] On her journey, she found her old prince Erazmin, transforming into nothing more than a [[The Rusty Prince|rusty bot]]. Putting him to rest gave Izira an idea. Inside a [[Armored Vaultbot]] nearby, there was a [[Visual Holo Sphere]], which held secrets to defeat King Mechagon. She asked an adventurer to retrieve it and send it to her main timeline self.[[Be Kind, Rewind]] ==Geography== Mechagon is a small island located northwest of [[Kul Tiras]] and has a similar landscape and fauna as [[Stormsong Valley]]. [[Rustbolt]], home to the [[Rustbolt Resistance]], is located on the northeast of the island while the entrance to [[Mechagon City]], the [[Junkwatt Depot]], is found in the southwestern hills. North lies a small mountainous area where the [[Scrapbone]] [[trogg]]s make their home within [[Scrapbone Den]]. Southwest lies a small cluster of islands known as the [[Toothy Shallows]]. ===Maps and subregions=== [[File:VZ-Mechagon Island.jpg|thumb|left|Map of Mechagon.]] {| class="darktable hlist" |- | *[[Burned Cave|The Burned Cave]] *[[Crystalized Cavern]] *[[Echo's Hovel]] *[[Engineer's Respite]] *[[Fleeting Forest|The Fleeting Forest]] **[[Bloody Grotto]] *[[Heaps (Mechagon Island)|The Heaps]] **[[Bondo's Yard]] **[[Crashcog Circuit]] **[[Crumbling Cavern]] *[[Junkwatt Depot]] *[[Outflow|The Outflow]] **[[Broken Point]] *[[Overspark Expedition Camp]] *[[Prospectus Bay]] **''[[Greasy Eel|The Greasy Eel]]'' *[[Rustbolt]] *[[Scrapbone Den]] **[[Grunters Hideout]] **[[Hungry Rest]] **[[Moch'k's Hole]] **[[Scavenger's Alcove]] **[[Scrapbone's Hollow]] **[[Sourback Hideout]] *[[Sparkweaver Point]] *[[Tinted Cave]] *[[Toothy Shallows]] **[[Rustrock Cavern]] **[[Western Spray]] ---- ;[[Operation: Mechagon|Mechagon instance]] *[[Mechagon City]] — [[Ampvolt Arcade]] *[[Bowelworks|The Bowelworks]] *[[Cogwrench Alley]] *[[Election Heights]] *[[High Tinkertory|The High Tinkertory]] *[[Machinist's Garden]] *[[Robodrome|The Robodrome]] *[[Under Junk|The Under Junk]] ---- ;[[Undisplayed location]]s *[[Tipsy Tinkerer|The Tipsy Tinkerer]] |} {{clear|left}} ===Instances=== {| class="darktable zebra" !Instance name !Level range !Group size !Approximate run time |- |{{portal|Operation: Mechagon|bfa}} || 120 |5 player |Unknown |} ==Quests== {{Main|Mechagon storyline}} ==Notes and trivia== *Mechagon Island shares some of its fauna with [[Stormsong Valley]], such as the [[Brinebeak Albatross]]es and the [[Coral Snapper]] crabs. *[[Ionized Minnow]]s scourge the waters around the island. They strip the ocean floors of any food, making it difficult for other species to survive.[[Tidying Up]] *[[Ion Hazzikostas]] has described Mechagon as "what you might expect from a gnomish paradise".{{Ref web|url=https://www.polygon.com/platform/amp/2019/4/5/18286344/|title=World of Warcraft’s next patch tackles Battle for Azeroth’s biggest flaws|author=Cass Marshall|work=Polygon|date=2019-04-05|accessdate=2019-04-08}} *Someone or something from Mechagon is called "Mechagonian".[[Mechagonian Sawblades]] *[[Snooter]]s were first discovered on Mechagon. They appear to be pets of the Mechagnomes, as the [[Golden Snorf]] was [[King Mechagon]]'s pet. *As a zone, Mechagon is slightly bigger than the [[Timeless Isle]] and smaller than [[Nazjatar]].{{Ref web|url=https://www.wowhead.com/news=291015/|title=Buffed.de 8.2 Interview with Ion Hazzikostas - Azshara Plot Twist, Class Diversity, Leveling|author=perculia|work=Wowhead|date=2019-04-03|accessdate=2019-04-08}} ==Speculation== {{Speculation}} The old vrykul presence on the island is most likely the [[Drust]].
